note: Aperture sums with a local sky annulus, no aperture correction: compare points with each other, not with catalogue magnitudes. Wavelength is the filter centre at the source's pixel in that exposure.
wing_note: Flux in a ring around the core, for stars whose core saturates. Tracks brightness over time; the ring holds a different share of the light at different wavelengths, so don't read spectral shape from it.

psf.method: forced fit of SPHEREx's official ePSF (EPSF table of the level-2 files, nearest detector region), amplitude only, pixels within 18.5" of the source, local sky from the aperture annulus, Gaia neighbours within the fit (any brightness, free amplitudes) fitted at the same time, except ones closer than 0.7 px, whose light counts with the source; flux is the total in the 33x33 ePSF box
